appTitle.zh: Research 3D Studio · 科研出图工作区

privacy.zh: 本地处理 · 文件不上传

packProjectHint.en: Include models and textures for use on another computer
packProjectHint.zh: 把模型与纹理一起打包，可在其他电脑打开

appendWorkspace.zh: ＋ 追加工作区 / 文件夹

chooseWorkspaceHint.en: Choose a folder to organize its 3D models and textures.
chooseWorkspaceHint.zh: 选择文件夹，自动整理其中的 3D 模型与纹理。

subheading.en: Organize models, compare views, and export every angle.
subheading.zh: 整理模型，同步对照，把每一个视角保存下来。

searchPlaceholder.en: Search files, categories, methods, or prompts…
searchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索文件、类别、方法或 prompt…

deltaInitial.en: Δ = OURS − BASE; missing values appear last.
deltaInitial.zh: Δ = OURS − BASE；空值排在末尾。

emptyHint1.en: Drop models or a folder, or choose a workspace on the left.
emptyHint1.zh: 拖入模型或整个文件夹，或者从左侧选择工作区。

emptyHint2.en: Files are read and rendered locally in your browser.
emptyHint2.zh: 文件只在当前浏览器内读取和渲染。

interactionHint.en: Scroll inside a canvas to zoom, outside to scroll the page · Drag to rotate · Right-drag to pan
interactionHint.zh: 画布内滚轮缩放模型，画布外滚动页面 · 拖动旋转 · 右键平移

compareEmptyHint1.en: Select models in the library, then click “Compare selection”.
compareEmptyHint1.zh: 在模型库勾选模型，点击「同步对照」。

compareEmptyHint2.en: Click a thumbnail to preview a model. Compare up to four models per page.
compareEmptyHint2.zh: 每页最多显示 4 个模型；单击缩略图可直接预览。

focusHint.en: Click a model title to select it, then adjust its axes and transform on the right.
focusHint.zh: 点击模型标题选中它，再在右侧调整轴向和姿态。

transformHint.en: Transforms apply to preview and export, and are saved in the project.
transformHint.zh: 变换只作用于查看与导出，记录在工程中。

lightHint.en: Position key, fill, and rim lights relative to the camera. Uses existing surface colors; no AI delighting or material reconstruction.
lightHint.zh: 根据视角自动布置主光、补光和轮廓光。使用已有表面颜色；不执行 AI 去光照或材质重建。

surfaceHint.en: Gaussian normals, clay, and relighting use the companion mesh. The export manifest records the source representation.
surfaceHint.zh: Gaussian 的法线、灰模和重光照由配对网格提供，导出清单会标明表示来源。

depthHint.en: Camera-space Z as 8-bit PNG grayscale, clipped to the selected range. The manifest records the range and normalization.
depthHint.zh: 相机空间 Z，PNG 8-bit 灰度；区间外截断。范围与归一化变换记录在素材清单。

metadataHint.en: Edits are saved in the project, leaving source files intact. Methods with the same sample ID are paired for Δ.
metadataHint.zh: 修改后写入工程；不改原文件。相同样本 ID 的不同方法用于 Δ 配对。

exportHint.en: The ZIP includes individual PNGs, editable SVG sheets, and a JSON manifest. All exported images have transparent backgrounds.
exportHint.zh: ZIP 包含独立 PNG、可编辑 SVG 拼图与 JSON 素材清单。所有导出图片均为透明底。

dropTypes.zh: 模型 · 文件夹 · 工程 ZIP

help1.en: Choose one or more workspaces. Compare each workspace as a group, or group by one to three subfolder levels.
help1.zh: 选择工作区，或追加多个工作区。每个工作区可整组比较，或按 1–3 层子目录分组。

help2.en: Matching models line up automatically. Missing methods stay empty; unmatched and conflicting names remain grouped by folder. You can change the matching rule.
help2.zh: 同名模型自动成行；缺少的方法留空，未匹配或重名冲突按文件夹保留。可调整匹配规则。

help3.en: Click “Compare row” for synchronized views. Page through more than four methods, and add any number of models to the export queue.
help3.zh: 点击「对照本行」同步查看。超过 4 个方法可翻页，全部模型都可加入导出队列。

help4.en: Adjust the camera, axes, and lighting. Original color, relighting, and data passes remain separate.
help4.zh: 调整相机、轴向和布光。原色、重光照与数据通道分别保留。

help5.en: Download a single image, or batch-export models, views, and passes.
help5.zh: 下载单张图片，或批量导出不同模型、视角和通道。

help6.en: Save settings as a project JSON, or pack a project ZIP that includes the files.
help6.zh: 保存工程 JSON 记录配置，或打包 ZIP 连同文件一起保存。

helpMetrics.en: Metrics CSVs use path, sample, method, category, prompt, and custom numeric columns. Δ pairs by sample and requires exactly one valid score for each method.
helpMetrics.zh: 指标 CSV 使用 path、sample、method、category、prompt 和自定义数值列。Δ 通过 sample 配对，仅当两种方法各有一条记录且分数有效时计算。

helpFolders.en: Folder connections depend on browser support. Chrome / Edge can retain folder handles and rescan; other browsers use snapshots that must be reimported after changes. Project JSON does not include model files.
helpFolders.zh: 目录连接依赖浏览器支持。Chrome / Edge 可保留目录句柄并重新扫描；其他浏览器使用文件夹快照，更新后重新导入。工程 JSON 不包含模型文件。

helpGaussian.en: Gaussian splats have no reliable surface material. Pair a mesh for normals and relighting. Rendered pixels may vary slightly across devices.
helpGaussian.zh: 普通 Gaussian 没有可靠的表面材质；配对网格后，法线和重新布光使用网格。跨设备的渲染像素可能有细微差异。

workspaceHint.en: Choose a workspace, then add folders to compare across workspaces.
workspaceHint.zh: 选择一个工作区，再追加其他文件夹进行对照。

refreshHint.en: Rescan connected folders. Use each workspace’s update button for snapshots.
refreshHint.zh: 扫描所有已连接目录；文件快照请使用各工作区的更新按钮

removeWorkspaceHint.zh: 移除此工作区（不删除文件）

deltaNote.en: Δ = OURS − BASE, paired by sample. Missing or duplicate pairs stay empty; imported units are preserved.
deltaNote.zh: Δ = OURS − BASE，同一样本配对；缺失或重复配对留空。数值保持导入量纲。

metricNote.en: Sort by imported values; missing scores stay empty and appear last.
metricNote.zh: 按导入数值排序；缺失留空并排在末尾。

nameConflict.en: Name conflict · Use relative paths or change grouping
nameConflict.zh: 重名冲突 · 改用组内相对路径或调整分组

unmatchedTitle.zh: 未匹配模型 · 按文件夹保留

noVisibleModels.en: No models to show. Check the filters and enabled folders.
noVisibleModels.zh: 没有可显示的模型，请检查筛选条件和参与对照的文件夹。

alreadyConnected.en: This folder is already connected. Refreshing…
alreadyConnected.zh: 该目录已经连接，正在刷新…

snapshotRefresh.en: These workspaces are snapshots. Use “Update / reconnect” for each workspace.
snapshotRefresh.zh: 当前工作区为文件快照，请使用各工作区的「更新 / 重新连接」。

syncedFiles.en: Synced changes from all accessible workspaces
syncedFiles.zh: 已同步所有可访问工作区的文件变化

surfaceRequired.en: This pass requires a surface mesh. Showing original color; pair a mesh or choose another pass.
surfaceRequired.zh: 此通道需要表面网格；当前显示原色。请配对网格或切换通道。

projectRestored.zh: 工程与相机设置已恢复

loadingDemo.zh: 读取随应用提供的示例…

lightEnabled.en: Auto lighting enabled: lights follow the view direction; original color remains available separately
lightEnabled.zh: 自动布光已启用：灯光随观察方向布置，原色通道保持独立

invalidTransformInput.en: Enter valid rotation values and a positive scale
invalidTransformInput.zh: 请输入有效的旋转和正缩放

projectSaved.en: Project saved. Reconnect model files when opening it in another browser.
projectSaved.zh: 工程已保存；在其他浏览器打开时需重新连接模型文件

portableSaved.en: Portable project saved with models, textures, and all settings
portableSaved.zh: 便携工程已保存，包含模型、纹理和全部设置

cancelAfterImage.en: Stopping after the current image finishes…
cancelAfterImage.zh: 将在当前图片完成后停止…

previousSettings.en: Previous settings restored. Choose a workspace or open a portable project to reload models.
previousSettings.zh: 已恢复上次设置；选择工作区或打开便携工程以重新载入模型

packingFigures.en: Packing individual PNGs, editable sheets, and the manifest…
packingFigures.zh: 打包独立 PNG、可编辑拼图与参数清单…

metadataArray.en: Metrics must be an array of records or an object with an assets array
metadataArray.zh: 指标文件应为记录数组，或包含 assets 数组

metadataPath.en: Each metrics record must include a path column
metadataPath.zh: 每条指标记录必须有 path 列

invalidAngles.zh: 视角请输入 1–24 个逗号分隔的角度

invalidDepth.en: Far depth must be greater than near depth
invalidDepth.zh: 深度上限必须大于下限

unsupportedSettings.zh: 工程包含不支持的显示设置

invalidProject.en: This is not a Research 3D Studio v1 project
invalidProject.zh: 不是 Research 3D Studio v1 工程

invalidPaths.en: Project paths are duplicated or invalid

networkResource.en: The model references a network resource. Include textures in the workspace alongside the model.
networkResource.zh: 模型引用了网络资源；请把纹理与模型一起放入工作区

emptyModel.en: Model is empty or contains invalid coordinates
emptyModel.zh: 模型为空或包含无效坐标

gaussianPass.en: Gaussian splats need a companion surface mesh to export this pass
gaussianPass.zh: Gaussian 需要配对表面网格才能导出此通道

pointCloudPass.en: Point clouds do not provide surface normals, depth, or lighting passes
pointCloudPass.zh: 点云不提供表面法线、深度或布光通道

exportSize.en: Export size exceeds this device’s limit
exportSize.zh: 导出尺寸超过设备上限

waitForExport.en: Wait for the current export to finish

demoResource.en: Failed to load a demo asset

unsupportedPass.en: This model does not support the pass. Pair a mesh or choose original color.
unsupportedPass.zh: 当前模型不支持此通道，请配对网格或选择原色

selectExportPasses.en: Select at least one export pass
selectExportPasses.zh: 至少选择一个导出通道

exportBudget.en: This batch exceeds the 1 GiB pixel-buffer budget. Use fewer models, passes, or views, or reduce resolution and export in batches.
exportBudget.zh: 该批次的像素缓冲预算超过 1 GiB。请减少模型 / 通道 / 视角，或降低分辨率后分批导出。

meshPassUnavailable.en: The companion mesh cannot provide this pass
meshPassUnavailable.zh: 配对网格无法提供此通道

noSurfacePass.en: This representation has no surface mesh; the pass is unavailable
noSurfacePass.zh: 此表示无表面网格，通道不适用

invalidSourceIds.en: Invalid workspace identity or grouping depth
invalidSourceIds.zh: 工程工作区标识或分组层级无效

invalidGroups.zh: 工程对照分组设置无效

workspaceSummary.en: Workspaces: {count} · Connected folders: {connected} · Snapshots: {snapshots}. Add folders to compare across workspaces.
workspaceSummary.zh: {count} 个工作区 · {connected} 个目录连接 · {snapshots} 个快照。追加文件夹可跨工作区对照。

matchSummary.en: Groups: {groups} · Matched samples: {matches}{conflicts}. A filter match keeps the entire comparison row.
matchSummary.zh: {groups} 个对照组 · {matches} 个同名组合{conflicts}。筛选命中任一模型时保留整行对照。

filesRead.zh: {workspace} · 已读取 {models} 个模型、{files} 个文件{notice}

refreshFailures.en: Could not refresh these workspaces; previous contents are retained: {names}
refreshFailures.zh: 以下工作区未能刷新，已保留之前内容：{names}

comparePage.en: Methods {start}–{end} / {total} · Camera stays synchronized across pages
comparePage.zh: 方法 {start}–{end} / {total} · 翻页保留同步相机

changedFiles.en: File contents changed; previous transforms were not applied: {names}
changedFiles.zh: 有文件内容变化，未套用旧变换：{names}

missingModels.zh: 仍有 {count} 个模型待连接工作区

unauthorizedFolders.en: Some folders still need permission: {names}. Reconnect them individually.
unauthorizedFolders.zh: 部分目录尚未授权：{names}，可单独重新连接

comparisonAdded.en: Models added: {count}. Page through all methods, with up to four synchronized viewports per page.
comparisonAdded.zh: 已加入 {count} 个模型，可翻页查看全部方法；每页最多 4 个同步视口

metricsImported.zh: 导入 {count} 条指标记录；匹配 {models} 个模型

batchExported.en: Exported PNGs: {count}, with editable SVGs · Unavailable or failed passes recorded: {skipped}
batchExported.zh: 已导出 {count} 张 PNG 与可编辑 SVG；{skipped} 个不适用或失败通道已记录

pathConflict.en: Duplicate path: {path}. Import the parent folder instead.
pathConflict.zh: 同名路径冲突：{path}。请导入父文件夹。

csvColumns.en: Column count does not match on CSV line {line}
csvColumns.zh: CSV 第 {line} 行列数不一致

nonFiniteMetric.en: Metric {metric} in {path} is not a finite number
nonFiniteMetric.zh: 指标 {metric} 在 {path} 中不是有限数值

missingModel.en: Could not find {path}. Reconnect the original workspace.
missingModel.zh: 未找到 {path}，请重新连接原工作区

missingSource.en: No workspace matches the project file: {path}
missingSource.zh: 工程文件没有对应工作区：{path}

duplicateFile.en: A file named {path} already exists. Add a folder to keep both copies.
duplicateFile.zh: 同名文件 {path} 已存在，请通过追加文件夹来保留两份。

sourceOverlap.en: Workspace path overlaps an added workspace: {path}. Remove and re-add that workspace.
sourceOverlap.zh: 工作区目录与已追加工作区的路径重叠：{path}。请移除后重新添加该追加工作区。

sourceConflict.en: Workspace path conflict: {path}. Remove and re-add the workspace.
sourceConflict.zh: 工作区路径冲突：{path}。请移除后重新添加该工作区。
